items.title: 67559_Art Hodes oral history interview
items.q: And then here comes Joe Bushkin, where did he come from?

ctx.x: No, he hadn't arrived yet, he hadn't come in. I was -- and Joe hadn't come on the scene yet. Bushkin hadn't arrived. So the next night, I did bring the tuxedo with me, because in Chicago at that time there were so many jobs that called for a tuxedo and you had to own one. The revolution didn't come til later.
